originality.rationale: PASS at qualified best-of-knowledge level, and significantly limited by close primary precedent. Koller–Hudcová (arXiv:2508.09768, 2025) explicitly formulate *left-translated two-step cycles for Rule 6*, give general transfer-matrix equations (20)–(21), and plot corresponding entropy profiles. Thus neither the Rule 6 shifted predicate, positive translated-wave entropy in general, nor the matrix method is novel. Their inspected full article does not state the exact all-length Rule 6 spatial periodic-point polynomial, the six nonzero eigenvalues, or the rational Artin–Mazur zeta displayed here; the surviving contribution is that precise nontrivial natural invariant. The published 256-rule temporal-two zeta census concerns *unshifted* Fix(F²), so does not mechanically specialize to Fix(R^-2F²). However older program output or unindexed Rule 6 tables may already contain these exact coefficients, an especially material residual priority risk. Do not present this as a new theory of traveling waves. Crucially, the primary author's supplementary CSVs were now read at the exact Rule 6, p=0,c=2,left-translation row: eigenvalues.csv already reports leading λ≈1.5436890126920757 and second λ≈1; table_entropy.csv already reports s≈0.43417501466531766. These numerical leading-rate values are definitely prior coverage and are NOT original in this record. The remaining mathematical assertion for originality is the full exact all-length spatial zeta denominator, all trace coefficients and recurrence; the archived CSVs do not list these.
